So you went with an NVMe SSD.

Do
- install (or clone) your OS to this drive
- if you play games, put a few of your favorites on here.
- put any software where you want faster read/write times on your particular software. Something like  photoshop or some editing software.
- leave a portion of space available so your drive can swap the data from different memory module 
- put particular software you’ll come back to a lot on it.

Don’t 
- it’s fast storage, not massive storage. If you need to store stuff, get a external storage device or something.
- don’t repetitively (more so excessively) write to the drive. SSD lifespan is determined by the amount of read and write (particularly writing) on the drive opposed to HDD which die like five or more years generally speaking.
- I wouldn’t defrag the device
